messages:
Ivy (Growth): Need a small asset set for the launch: animated GIF hero (looping sparkline), two stat cards, and a 1-slide 'how it works' schematic. Audience: webinar registrants / blog readers. Due next Wed.

Sam (Designer): Sounds good. GIF constraints? duration, frame count, and color usage?

Ivy (Growth): Keep under 3s, 20 fps max, and <2MB for web. Use brand gradient + graphite accents. GIF should show cost decline sparkline and a micro-copy overlay: 'Up to 60% lower per-token cost'. Add an alt-text block for accessibility.

Rae (PMM): Legal note: "Up to 60%" preferred. Add footnote text: "Based on internal Q4 conversational eval; results vary." Include a NOTES panel in Figma with data links.

Sam (Designer): Will build componentized charts so we can swap copy. Will provide .fig, .svg, animated GIF, and a PNG fallback. Naming: launch_gif_hero_v1, launch_stat_1_v1, launch_stat_2_v1, launch_diagram_v1.

Omar (Creative Ops): Localization: need text layers and a CSV keymap. Also ask for a copy-safe area for translations (10% horizontal padding). For GIF, include a still frame with editable overlay.

Sam (Designer): Adding a STILL frame and a NOTES frame with data-sources.txt and copy-keys.csv. Will export an 'accessibility.txt' with alt text and contrast ratios.

LegalBot: Flagged: ensure contrast ratio >=4.5 for body text and provide the eval snapshot CSV for review. Also request the methodology blurb.

Ivy (Growth): Uploading eval snapshot to drive now: https://storage.redwood.ai/marketing/eval_q4_launch.csv. Please annotate in NOTES.

Sam (Designer): First pass in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/launch-fig/bench-mini. I'll post exports by EOD tomorrow.

Omar (Creative Ops): I'll open localization + legal review tickets once exports land. Target final: Tue morning.

Ivy (Growth): Thanks all ":thumbsup:" — please keep copy modular for A/B (absolute vs up-to).
